text_block_list.text:
...I ran with the resolve to win next 
time, but...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
choice_data_list: It's okay, let's get stronger together!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. I was just thinking about that 
too.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Getting straight to it, is it possible to 
watch it? The replay video of the race 
just now."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
There's one thing that comes to mind. You 
know, that turning point between victory 
and defeat?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Once I get a hold of that, it's mine.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
You never know the ending until the end 
credits roll.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Audience members who stood up during the 
end credits of defeat hurried back as 
cheers erupted across the theater.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Aha, this is giving me the absolute 
greatest chills!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
What's with the sudden change? Did the 
Trainer of Light just descend upon us?
choice_data_list:
For you, I'll even become the Trainer of 
Light!

Light!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Well, honestly, I was just lost in 
thought earlier, but..."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Feels like I got a pretty nice buff, 
teehee.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainy of Light, right?
